findings.explanation: Your quarterly payments are conditional and deferred if specific revenue targets are not met, making payment indefinite and dependent on performance milestones.
findings.suggested_change: Co-Host shall make all quarterly payments on the scheduled dates regardless of whether the Minimum Revenue Targets are achieved.

findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.
findings.explanation: Your liability is capped at fifteen million dollars, but claims under Section 9 (including indemnification and intellectual property infringement obligations) are excluded from this cap and have no separate limit.
findings.suggested_change: The liability of either party for direct damages under this Agreement, including any claims under Section 9, shall not exceed fifteen million dollars.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to request a couple of updates before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, quarterly payments are currently deferred if specific revenue targets are not met, and I propose that the agreement be revised so that all quarterly payments are made on the scheduled dates regardless of whether those targets are achieved. - Regarding the liability provision, certain claims are currently excluded from the overall damage cap, and I propose that the relevant clause be updated so that all claims under the agreement are subject to the same liability cap. Thank you for your time and cooperation.
